active_work_item.title: Useful free preview and deterministic unlock gate
active_work_item.reason: Builder implemented the bounded CP5 presentation gate on a scoped PR. Preview data omits gated finding/section content instead of CSS-hiding it; deterministic server-rendered demo unlock reveals the same already-produced report at CA$14.99 one-time copy. Exact-head CI is green. Independent QA must verify before completion.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings
